title: agent.spawned payload
description: The swarm runtime spawned an agent (api-contracts.md 2.3.9). parent is absent for the root agent of a world; content_hash of the blueprint is optional (contracts.md C-07 v1.1) and lets an operator tell two runs of the same version apart.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the normalised blueprint (ADR-015 p. 1) in the form sha256:<64 lowercase hex> (contracts.md C-07 v1.3), carried as a string and never as a number: the bus decodes a payload into map[string]any, where a JSON number becomes a float64, and 256 bits of hash would come back a different value — the same trap dice.rolled.roll.seed was measured falling into on T-015.
